text_block_list.text:
One day, while chatting with Verxina,
we overheard an intriguing conversation—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
You'll feel better once you talk it out, Chevalier-san.
Wait, you... what are you doing in front of the staff room?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Um... well...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! My apologies.
Um, it's not that I'm trying to blame you!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Are you having some kind of trouble?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Mmh... That notebook is for English, isn't it?
Were you looking for the English teacher?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Oh, just as I thought! In that case,
they might be in the reference room.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Whenever you are in trouble, do not hesitate to call upon me!
I shall assist you with even the smallest matter.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Fenomeno-san, thank you so much for helping my little sister earlier.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Verxina-san!
Something like this is no trouble at all!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Next time I'll keep my antennae raised even higher
and sniff out any SOS instantly, yes sir!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I am relying on you very much.
On both you and all the members of the Disciplinary Committee.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...She must understand it as well.

And the next day, I came across Cheval Grand
in a similar situation once more—

text_block_list.name: Disciplinary Committee Member
text_block_list.text:
Um, do you need something from me?
You've been staring this way for a while—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Um—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Cheval...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Mmh... It seems best to step in and help.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: No. Please wait, Fenomeno-san.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Please, do not do anything.
Just watch over me.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? B-But...
Are you really sure?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. Just like this.
—I'm sure everything will be fine."

text_block_list.name: Disciplinary Committee Member
text_block_list.text:
"...? If you don't have any particular business with me,
I'll be taking my leave."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: P-P-Please... wait...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...I found this notebook.
Someone must have left it behind.

text_block_list.name: Disciplinary Committee Member
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, lost property, right!
Where did you happen to find it?"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: At that... cafe table over there.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
P-Please return this to its owner.
I'm begging you...!

text_block_list.name: Disciplinary Committee Member
text_block_list.text:
Yes, leave it to me!
I'll take custody of it responsibly!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Well done, Cheval.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Cheval-san, you look like a whole new person!
You look magnificent, sir!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that progress will serve as nourishment.
...However, this is where the real journey begins.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Until she can convey her thoughts more smoothly, she'll have to overcome many more hurdles.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
So you won't lend a hand unnecessarily.
Hehe, you have high expectations, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: After all, Cheval is a younger sister I'm proud of.
choice_data_list: Cheval did a fantastic job today!
Watching over someone's growth is hard work too, huh?
Watching over someone's growth is hard work too, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: After all, Cheval is a younger sister I'm proud of.
choice_data_list: Cheval did a fantastic job today!
Watching over someone's growth is hard work too, huh?
Watching over someone's growth is hard work too, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I want to praise them lots and lots.
...Right this instant.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Well done, Cheval.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
B-Big Sister...!
You weren't watching, were you...?!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I saw everything until the very end.
You were magnificent, Cheval!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
That, too, is the duty of those who lead the way.
Sometimes, endurance is required.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I see... It truly is difficult, sir.
I reflexively find myself reaching out to help.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I completely understand how you feel.
After all—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Me too.
I gripped so tightly that my palms are bright red.
